title: Open Position: Sales Assistant
paragraphs: Bright Leaf Media has a new opening in the sales department. We seek a candidate who has strong communication skill and at least two year of experience in a related field. A resume and a short cover letter are required for every application.

The successful applicant will join a friendly team and receive a competitive salary plus benefit such as health insurance and paid leave. Coaching is offered in the first month to help new staff onboard smoothly and feel welcome.

A university qualification in business or a related field is preferred but not required. Teamwork and communication matter more than formal qualification alone. A selected candidate will be invited for an interview next week, and a reference check will follow before any formal offer.
